verdict.rationale: Trello's official REST API reference lists a 'Webhooks' resource alongside Batch and Search. That is first-party evidence of an outbound webhook capability, but it is only a bare section heading. No details on registering callbacks, supported event types, payloads or delivery behavior appear in the pack. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration flow, event/model coverage, payload and verification details, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
